name: Blight
rationale: Poison, draining focus and decay choke living growth, with Bone and Mushroom marking its corruption.

parts.rationale: Native harmful brewing motif; optional Iron Blood focus

clues: Outer Plinths hold bone motif, poison motif; the other required ingredients use Inner Plinths.
Leave the first outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Leave the third outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Mushroom motif follows blank inscription clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
Bone motif follows mushroom motif clockwise.
Enemy decay follows bone motif clockwise.
Draining focus follows enemy decay clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
Poison motif follows draining focus clockwise.
Blank inscription follows poison motif clockwise.
